notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
easyPrerequisites:
Servant of Tymaret doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ioreth of the Healing House is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping Servant of Tymaret
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
